historic_district.name: Alamo Square Historic District
historic_district.note: An Article 10 local historic district — this parcel does carry local landmark protection, unlike the California-Register-only districts elsewhere on this site.

notable_residents.name: Alice Walker
notable_residents.detail: The source records Walker as living here until 1996, and describes the house as one of the Painted Ladies of Alamo Square, known as Postcard Row or the Seven Sisters.

permits.description: renewal of the 2001 permit for final sign-off

narrative.lead: One of the Painted Ladies facing Alamo Square — the row photographed as Postcard Row, or the Seven Sisters — built around 1900. SF Planning records it under the name Postcard Row (part). A published guide to notable residences records Alice Walker as living here until 1996.

sections.heading: Permit history
sections.body: Only three permits are on file. The building has no substantial recorded alteration history — fitting for a house whose street-facing appearance is the point of its protection.
